o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *kiarïnč-ɣa, from Proto-Turkic *karïnčga (“ant”). Doublet of qarışqa. Cognate with Turkish karınca, Crimean Tatar qarınca, Turkmen garynja (“ant”).
Borrowed from Arabic سطحي. By surface analysis, səth + -i.
